notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Stuff': Tatooine (Light) (Premiere), Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Tatooine: Cantina (Light), Heading For The Medical Frigate, Insurrection, Squadron Assignments and Staging Areas; these count toward the deck. The heading 'Starting Stuff' is not a card.

The Watch Your Step objective is not in the posted list, although the description and strategy play it ("the flip side of WYS", "keep the objective flip"); it is not added. starting.card is the starting site Tatooine: Docking Bay 94. starting.effect is left empty (the strategy starts three Effects, none named as the starting Effect).
Total 59 as published (the objective is missing from the list).
Posted 'Tatooine' and 'Tatooine Cantina' dested the Light Premiere system and Light Cantina; 'Tatooine Lars' Moisture Farm' dested the Light Premiere site.

Posted 'Jedi Luke' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'EPP Luke' dested Luke With Lightsaber; 'Talon Karde' dested Talon Karrde; 'Millenium Falcon' dested Millennium Falcon; 'Artoo in Red 5' dested Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'What're You Trying To Push On Us?' dested What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?; 'Out of Commision & Transmission Terminated' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated.

An earlier version of Spencer Ball's later 'Ball's WYS/Smuggler Festival' (DeckTech 15237, 13 April 2001), which lists the objective and swaps a few cards (Obi-Wan Kenobi, Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, Clash Of Sabers, Old Ben in; Mirax Terrik, Darklighter Spin, Artoo-Detoo In Red 5 and others out).
